insights.content: Your average post-meal glucose was 155 mg/dL in January and is now 130 mg/dL, a 16% improvement over 3 months of consistent tracking (n=108, 81% confidence).
insights.title: Post-meal glucose spikes have decreased 16% since you started logging

insights.content: On days following Berberine intake, your fasting glucose averaged 98 mg/dL versus 107 mg/dL on days without (Δ 9 mg/dL, n=160, 78% confidence).
insights.title: Berberine correlates with lower fasting glucose readings

insights.content: Across 4 completed cycles, your average length is 40.5 days (range 38-44). This is consistent with longer PCOS cycles but within a stable range (n=4, 72% confidence).
insights.title: Your cycles average 40 days with moderate variability

insights.content: You logged energy crashes 2.4x more frequently the day after medium/high GI meals compared to low-GI meal days (n=80, 75% confidence).
insights.title: Energy crashes tend to follow high-GI meals the next day

insights.content: On days with 35+ active minutes, your average sleep was 7.4 hours versus 6.5 hours on less active days (Δ 0.9h, n=45, 68% confidence).
insights.title: Active days above 35 minutes correlate with better sleep quality
